Sorcerer Supreme of Marvel Earth.

How Doctor Strange connects

  • Creator: Steve Ditko — Steve Ditko co-created Doctor Strange.
  • Concept: Multiverse — Doctor Strange guards multiversal threats.

What is Doctor Strange?

Doctor Strange is Stephen Strange, mystic guardian against dimensional threats, co-created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko and key to MCU multiverse stories.

Key threads lead to Steve Ditko and Multiverse.
